test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

Plastic debris in the ocean can become coated with algae and other marine microbes that produces a chemical scent.

options.text: marine microbes that produces a chemical scent.
Plastic debris in the ocean can become

solution:
The correct answer is option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error is in "**marine microbes that produces a chemical scent**".
 
• The subject "**marine microbes**" is plural, but the verb "**produces**" is singular. It should be "**produce**" to agree with the subject.
 
• Option 1 ("coated with algae and other") is grammatically correct.
 
• Option 3 ("Plastic debris in the ocean can become") is also grammatically correct.
 
• Option 4 ("No error") is not the correct answer in this case, as there is an error in the sentence.
 
• Therefore, option 2 is correct.

Correct sentence__: Plastic debris in the ocean can become coated with algae and other marine microbes that __**produce**__ a chemical scent. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The sentence is discussing how plastic debris in the ocean can absorb and retain a chemical scent due to the growth of algae and other marine microbes on its surface. This can attract marine animals, leading to ingestion of the plastic and potential harm to the animals.
